description: One page (100 rows) of a region's Master+ ranked solo/duo ladder as TrackDIFF shows it: rank, Riot ID (summonerName#tagLine), tier/division/LP, wins/losses, LP change over `span`, whether the player is live-streaming or in a game, and their public persona (streamer/pro) if any. `board: "prestige"` is the global Master+ board filtered to ≥69% win rate and ignores `region`. Use `get_rank_cutoffs` for the Challenger/Grandmaster thresholds and `get_player_profile` for one player. Pages beyond 10 are not served — this is an answer, not a dataset.

role.description: Only players whose primary role is this.
